note: Single source of decoding/seed policy (issue #5). Changing any value changes the config hash, which is what the run manifest records. The runner (harness_run.py) reads ONLY this file for decoding and seed policy - no inline overrides.

A.prompt_suffix: Answer with the option index number only.

B.prompt_suffix: First name the most likely rule per column in one line, then give the option index number only on the last line.
B.deviation: Design arm B is top-k=10 first-token-branch CoT-decoding with confidence selection; the OpenAI-compatible serving endpoint cannot fork continuations per branch, so arm B is a CoT-prompted greedy continuation. Registered deviation (also on #8).

S.prompt_suffix: Let's think step by step. Then give the option index number only on the last line.
S.note: Secondary arm - quantifies the verbal-trigger gap (H0-b); analysis only, not a primary claim.

seed_policy.item_seeds: generators/digit_matrices.py --seed-base; each item carries seed + seed_hash = sha256('digit_matrices|level|seed')[:16]

retry_rule: one retry on HTTP 5xx / connection reset; a second failure marks the record outcome=error and stops (never a silent third).

raw_archive.format: one JSON object per prompt, sorted keys, public-only

endpoints: injected at run time (env/args), never in this file - the config is the policy, the endpoint is the environment
